label: Whenever a being gives another being, the giving exercises a power of the giver
paraphrase: OPEN (analyst formulation, unattributed): whenever, in a world v, y gives x being (GivesTo), there is an active power p of y (PowerOf) such that y's giving x being in v is an exercise of p (Exercises). Giving is an operation of the giver from one of its own principles. Omitting it lets a model give being while exercising nothing (an encoding artifact, controls).
